newsitem.title: USA: Kiddie Academy to be delisted by Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Kiddie Academy to be delisted by Nasdaq.

text.p: Kiddie Academy International Inc on Friday said its common stock and warrants were being delisted from the Nasdaq Small Capitalization Market, effective Monday, March 31.
The company said that the Nasdaq Listing Qualifications Panel determined that it was not in compliance with a rule that companies maintain capital and surplus of at least $1.0 million.
Kiddie Academy, which operates and franchises child-care centers, said it intended to appeal the panel's decision.
It said that trading of its securities may be conducted on the OTC Bulletin Board or in the over-the-counter market, commonly referred to as the pink sheets.
